watch.summary: The streamer passionately hypes up a Valorant pro player and promises a triple kill right before the team gets completely wiped through smoke.

beats.what: Streamer hypes up pro player Tuyu, telling him he is doing phenomenal
Streamer confidently predicts Tuyu is about to get a triple kill
The enemy team immediately sprays down Tuyu and his team in the dark
Streamer reacts in complete disbelief at the sudden shutdown

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Oh my word, how is he getting that?!
watch.why: The comedy stems from an immediate caster jinx where the streamer passionately promises a triple kill right before the play collapses. The high confidence followed instantly by utter defeat creates a classic comedic contrast.
